description: This file defines the TbKafkaProducerTemplate class, a Kafka producer wrapper for sending messages with headers and topic management, used within the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: TbKafkaProducerTemplate
classes.description: A generic Kafka producer template class for sending messages with headers, managing topics, and handling callbacks within the Thingsboard system.

methods.name: addAnalyticHeaders
methods.description: Adds headers containing producer ID, thread name, and optionally stack trace for tracing purposes.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message to a specified topic partition with optional callback.

methods.name: createTopicIfNotExist
methods.description: Creates a Kafka topic if it does not already exist in the internal cache.
